title: Aave V3 PoolAddressesProvider (Ethereum)
note: Registry of the Aave V3 Ethereum market: owner, ACL admin, and which Pool, PoolConfigurator and price oracle the market points to. A change here means an upgrade or a swap of core infrastructure.

title: Aave V3 Pool (Ethereum)
note: Listed reserves (getReservesList changes whenever governance lists a new asset) and the flash loan premium.

title: Compound III cUSDCv3 (Ethereum)
note: Governor, pause guardian, pause flags, number of collateral assets, and the interest rate curve (kinks and slopes). Rate parameters are retuned by governance every few weeks.

title: Compound III cWETHv3 (Ethereum)
note: Governor, pause guardian, pause flags, number of collateral assets, and the interest rate curve (kinks and slopes). Rate parameters are retuned by governance every few weeks.

title: USDC (Ethereum)
note: Privileged roles of the USDC token: owner, master minter, pauser, blacklister, rescuer, and the global pause flag.

title: USDT (Ethereum)
note: Owner, pause and deprecation flags (deprecated + upgradedAddress would redirect the token to a new contract), and the dormant transfer fee (basisPointsRate, maximumFee).

title: WBTC (Ethereum)
note: Owner of the WBTC token (the custody controller) and the pause flag.

title: Chainlink ETH / USD feed (Ethereum)
note: Feed proxy owner and the aggregator it points to (changes when Chainlink upgrades the feed), plus metadata consumers hard-code.

title: Chainlink BTC / USD feed (Ethereum)
note: Feed proxy owner and the aggregator it points to (changes when Chainlink upgrades the feed), plus metadata consumers hard-code.

title: Sky Savings Rate - sUSDS (Ethereum)
note: The Sky Savings Rate (ssr, a per-second rate in ray, 1e27) paid to USDS savers. Set by Sky governance executive votes and adjusted every few weeks to months. APY = (ssr / 1e27) ^ 31536000 - 1. chi/rho are left out: they move on every deposit.

title: Maker DAI Savings Rate - Pot (Ethereum)
note: The DAI Savings Rate (dsr, per-second rate in ray, 1e27) behind sDAI, and the live flag (0 after emergency shutdown). Changed by executive spells. APY = (dsr / 1e27) ^ 31536000 - 1.

title: SparkLend Pool (Ethereum)
note: Listed reserves of SparkLend (an Aave V3 fork run by Sky governance) and the flash loan premium. New assets are onboarded regularly.

title: Compound III cUSDTv3 (Ethereum)
note: Governor, pause guardian, pause flags, number of collateral assets (grows when collateral is onboarded), and the interest rate curve. Rate parameters are retuned by governance every few weeks.

title: Compound III cwstETHv3 (Ethereum)
note: Governor, pause guardian, pause flags, number of collateral assets (grows when collateral is onboarded), and the interest rate curve. Rate parameters are retuned by governance every few weeks.

note: Governor, pause guardian, pause flags, number of collateral assets (grows when collateral is onboarded), and the interest rate curve. Rate parameters are retuned by governance every few weeks.

title: Canary: Chainlink USDC / USD round (Ethereum)
note: CANARY - not a real finding, never post it. latestRound advances at least once a day (24h heartbeat), so this file drifts daily and exercises the whole issue -> PR -> merge loop. If it has not drifted for two days, the watch itself is broken. Delete it once the loop is trusted.
